study.question: Does the failed buy tower reduction partly reflect retained large-template initialization variance rather than removed representational capacity, and can a dimension-corrected reduced tower preserve click AUC at lower measured prediction cost?
study.hypothesis: The buy task alone supplies auxiliary context gradients. Reducing its tower from [112,64] to [96,48] retains coefficients drawn for the original [128,64] template. Its lower marginal variance can change the useful shared-context training signal under one pass. Deterministic dimension-specific variance correction may recover some click quality without adding parameters or prediction operations. This is unverified; successful or null private-head scale controls cannot establish transfer to a context-owning task.

nearest_work.difference: Primary text lines209-336 verifies inherited target-conditioned unnormalized local activation and Dice. This local adapted compressed four-task capacity/initialization factorial changes neither component and claims no architectural novelty or exact DIN replication.

Pinned primary implementation at commit90bb99a60724e975ec565836266fd86dcad0039d, lines309-323, uses Xavier-normal Linear weights and zero biases. We preserve its draws and apply deterministic fan-sum ratios only after all slicing, only to buy tower weights.

Nearest local scale diagnostic modified fully context-detached cart/fav towers and left click exactly unchanged while auxiliary AUC changed. Reuse its variance-correction helper on buy; add full versus reduced capacity as the second factor. This is a local mechanism diagnostic, not a new initialization method.

inherited_components: Full standalone source and literal parent architecture from history_g2_r0047_joint_owner_reference.py; immutable baseline unchanged
All template RNG draws, residual zero-output initialization and channel slicing
Unchanged representations, history masks, target-match/ordinal summaries and compression routes
Unchanged click/auxiliary scorer and item gradient blocking; buy-only auxiliary context updates
Existing generic private-initialization helper; no new arithmetic in forward
Same four independent probability outputs, BCE losses, evaluation affine/Dice factoring
study.proposed_difference: Add owner_initialization_scale in {inherited,xavier}. After all inherited constructor work and before device placement, xavier calls the existing rescaling helper on buy only, correcting both hidden and final readout Linear weights. At each layer multiply by sqrt(original template fan-sum / actual fan-sum), using template [128,64]. Cross with buy tower [112,64] versus [96,48]. Both full and reduced xavier cells are new; reference and reduced-inherited cells are bridge controls. No new draws, Parameters, buffers, inputs, loss weights or forward operators.
predictions: Bridge controls reproduce click AUC0.6671669182126774 (full) and0.6665210135841103 (reduced/inherited), along with all four task scores within host numerical tolerances; initial states and external RNG match archived sources.

The conditional scale benefit in reduced capacity exceeds that in full capacity if scale mismatch contributes to the reduction deficit. A scale main effect alone does not establish capacity-specific mediation.

Prospective screening preservation: click AUC must be at least0.6670669182126774 (current frozen incumbent minus absolute0.0001) AND no more than0.0001 below its same-scale full-width control. This criterion is fixed before these new runs; do not relabel old trials using it as if previously declared.

Full cells retain204531 dense and31997747 total parameters; reduced cells195491 dense and31988707 total, both31793216 embedding. Reduction is9040 dense coefficients (4.42% dense,0.0283% total), not a large model-memory reduction.

Utility additionally requires at least1% lower matched model-only p50 inference latency than the same-scale full control, p95 no more than1% worse, and no worse full-population examples/second. Parameter count alone does not establish prediction-cost savings; confirm timing across host-authorized repeated comparisons.
All task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean, fixed history-length slices and train/total wall time remain reported, including regressions. A click-preserving result need not preserve auxiliary utility.
falsifiers: Failed bridge state/RNG/score parity blocks the intended attribution and requires repair with failed costs retained.
Corrected reduction fails either preservation threshold or shows no repeatable measured prediction-cost reduction.
Scale correction changes no relevant quality deficit, or full capacity benefits equally: no support for capacity-specific scale mediation.
Any forbidden gradient path, mask violation, nonfinite forward/backward, changed training exposure or unexpected parameter/buffer difference invalidates that comparison.
alternative_explanations: True loss of useful buy tower capacity or residual/tower coadaptation
Single-pass optimization speed and AdamW scale sensitivity rather than preserved information
Shared context learning, batch-normalization dynamics and global dense clipping
Single fixed seed; deterministically repeated controls do not provide independent seeds or mechanism replications
Data-loading and GPU runtime noise can dominate the small dense arithmetic savings
The earlier private-head AUC response may not transfer to buy or click; source priority is not claimed
